synth.notes:
Player 5x5 ring (9, centre 5) steps 6; move iff dest box all floor 5, or it holds the plate centre (topmost 3x3 of rope 8).
Body (player/ghost) on plate: door block (arm rows +-3, 6 cols from arm start) shifts 6 toward the rope line; release shifts it back.
A5 = ghost-mode toggle: no colour-2 HUD ring -> record (ring 2 at (1,1), HUD x+4), ring present -> clear, both respawn; player on spawn -> no-op.
Ghost (colour 2) = player trail 2 successful moves behind, trail reset to [level start, spawn] on record; spawn = first lattice cell with all-5 box.
Counter row 63: n//2+1 cells colour 1 from right after call n; parity hidden (continuity-gated, fallback n=2z-1), unconfirmed beyond these observations.
